# Contributing

<!-- Generated by scrum-github (preset trunk). Edit it freely: init never overwrites it. -->

## Branches

| Branch | What it holds | Who writes to it |
|---|---|---|
| `{{RELEASE_BRANCH}}` | Everything that is merged. Every version tag (`{{TAG_PREFIX}}1.2.0`) is on this branch. | Pull requests only |
| `feat/<task>-<slug>`, `fix/...` | One task. Created from `{{RELEASE_BRANCH}}`. | You |

Nobody pushes to `{{RELEASE_BRANCH}}` directly: every change goes through a pull request, which needs the
required checks and the review.

## Pull requests

- Target `{{RELEASE_BRANCH}}`.
- The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org): a type (`feat`,
  `fix`, `docs`, `chore`, `refactor`, `test`, `ci`, `perf`, `build`, `revert`), an optional scope,
  `!` for a breaking change, then `: ` and a summary. Example: `feat(auth): log in with email`.
- The description closes its task: `Closes #<task number>`. A change without a task gets the
  `{{NO_TASK_LABEL}}` label instead.
- Pull requests are squash-merged. A task is Done when its pull request is merged.

## Releases

`/scrum-github:release` shows the next version and the release notes from the Done tasks; after
you confirm, it creates the tag on `{{RELEASE_BRANCH}}` and the GitHub Release.{{DEPLOY_SECTION}}
